title: Junior Estimator/Contract Administrator
content_text:
About us
Burland Contractors is an established Victorian civil and commercial landscape contractor. Our projects are varied, we work across education, health, commercial, retail and residential projects, delivering everything from quiet spaces of reflection, bustling playgrounds and functional hardscapes. We're a growing business that is big enough to be trusted yet small enough to be agile.
About the role
This is a varied, office-based role combining estimating and contract/project administration. You'll work with our Senior Estimator and project team on reviewing construction drawings, specifications and tender documents, completing quantity take-offs from landscape and construction drawings, and assisting with the preparation of project estimates and quotations.
Key responsibilities
- Reviewing construction drawings, specifications and tender documents
- Completing quantity take-offs from landscape and construction drawings
- Assisting with the preparation of project estimates and quotations
- Sending requests for pricing to suppliers and subcontractors
- Comparing and recording supplier quotations
- Maintaining current supplier, material and subcontractor pricing
- Assisting in the development and maintenance of our estimating price book
- Preparing tender documentation, inclusions, exclusions and supporting information
- Setting up and maintaining project and tender records
- Maintaining contracts, variations and other commercial project documentation
About you
- Strong attention to detail and good numerical skills
- Confidence using Excel and computer systems
- Good written and verbal communication
- The ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines
- An understanding of construction and how projects are priced and delivered
- The ability to read construction drawings, or the willingness to learn
- Experience in landscaping, civil or commercial construction would be highly regarded
- Experience with estimating or construction management software would be highly regarded, but is not essential
Apply through SEEK with your resume and a short introduction telling us about your experience and why the role interests you.
screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
What's your expected annual base salary?
How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
